When installing latest version of cheerio NPM gives the following warning:

```text
npm warn deprecated whatwg-encoding@3.1.1: Use @exodus/bytes instead for a more spec-conformant and faster implementation
```

Reason

The package [whatwg-encoding](https://www.npmjs.com/package/whatwg-encoding/v/3.1.1) got deprecated with an alternate to move to https://github.com/ExodusOSS/bytes.
